description:
Unit text, paged.

Past `max_chars` it is `truncated`: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for more.
Pages end after a paragraph, else after a space, else mid-word (a tiny
`max_chars`). Only page 1 lists `parts`, sub-units with their own `urn`,
unless `parts_offset` is passed.

`text: null` with status 'edition_text_unavailable' (edition not stored) or
'extraction_failed' (unit not cut out) is a unit that DOES exist -- not a
repeal. No unit at that address answers 'not_found'.

`text_since`: the edition this text first reads so; `edition_date` only dates
the act's latest change.
name: ua_law__get_unit_fulltext
title: Get Legal Provision Text
